name: Cairpre

attributes.attribute: fuller form that the variant Cairpre points to

text: Cairpre is a variant form of the name Cairbre. Early writers used both spellings for the same men. The shorter form Cairpre appears beside the fuller Cairbre in old manuscripts. Such a name belonged to heroes, kings, and poets across early Ireland. A reader who seeks full details should turn to the entry on Cairbre. This page records only the alternate spelling of the name.

okr.objective: Record Cairpre as a variant form of the Irish name Cairbre.
key_results: Cairpre is an alternate spelling of Cairbre.
The fuller story of the name sits under Cairbre.
